name: Recitation Masjid
summary: An open Quran forms the actual foundation of a mosque, with its gutter aligned directly beneath the doorway.
why: The mosque and Quran share x=54. The upper page edges at y=59 form the building foundation and directly contact both outer tower walls and both doorway jambs. A six-unit central fold opens beneath the doorway; its gutter continues to the lower book spine. The consistent 3.6-unit contour makes the architecture and pages one constructed identity.
risk: The integrated mark carries more information than a mosque alone. At 24px its Quran becomes a warm folded foundation, while the dome and twin minarets carry recognition.
reasonToChoose: You want mosque and Quran to carry equal meaning.
